issue.title: sase_memory_read skill should point agents at sase memory history -f json for past versions

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add a short section to the sase_memory_read skill source: when an agent needs how a memory note, web, strand, or AGENTS.md changed (past versions, diffs, the cross-file changes feed), use 'sase memory history <selector> -f json' (plus -A REV, -d, -l N). Note that viewing history never records an audited read, so it complements rather than replaces 'sase memory read'. Regenerate and redeploy the generated skills per the generated_skills memory note.

issue.creation_reason: Filed from sase-1dr.12 note #7 (tooling item 3) while landing epic sase-1dr; agents have a JSON history interface now but the reading skill never mentions it.

payload.description: Need open follow-up scope for TUI history design to avoid duplicating planned work
